_note: Integrity lens, round 3, carousel no. 71, returned by carousel-scorer and saved in shape. Its hard fail was repaired before ship.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Strong 1, 4 and 6 holding scale; 7's cards read as planks with fans 1.71 to 1 against 2.17; 8's blank folders and a leader through a label; mannequin officers.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One parcel, one key, one motif changing state; 7 an abstract close-up; 8 a declared cut.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Numerals trace and the round 2 attribution repairs hold. The 'In September' month is unsourced (hard fail); 7's 'at frame 6's scale' is false by the code; the caption drops 'approximately'; frame 1's brush trucks come from the December plan.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where land; no date or next step and the October 19th briefing goes unmentioned.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Reads in order with the turn at 6; 4 and 9 overlap.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register; a bare 'December' and procedural attribution lines.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New setting; familiar staged world; same item as no. 31, outside the window.

hard_fails: Slide 8's dek and the caption dated Chad West's withdrawal 'In September', and no claim supplies the month (c56 says only 'previously'). Repaired before ship: the month is struck from both surfaces.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Two flat planks, fans not proportional, 0.8 mm cards against the dek's claimed scale.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Frame 6's card thickness, a vertical step per card, proportional spacing, labels beside their fans.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Three identical blank folders and a leader through a label.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A seated eye, each folder in its own state, labels on one baseline.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A mannequin officer in a box vest competing with the column.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A three quarter back view looking up, a fitted vest, the sheaf in the key light.
